before: Under tracking, cell merge and split refused in every table, including the author's own pending table insertion.
after: Under tracking, cell merge and split work inside a table that is the author's own pending insertion. Rows, cells, and paragraph marks they add carry copies of that insertion's existing w:ins and w:cellIns markers.
reason: The edit writes only existing table, row, cell, paragraph, and revision-marker nodes, in the same shape that a tracked table insertion and an untracked merge or split already write. Released participants read, merge, and resolve these nodes with their current rules, so shared data keeps its meaning.
